attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `nap` and `ccm` genes.** Columns 0 to 18 are spine, carried by 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 5% of calls. The model names 97 to 99.8% of them, fewest at column 18 (`narP`), 97%, and hesitates most at column 2 (`yojO`), 0.95 bits.

**The first fork is at `yejO`**, column 19, in a region of plasticity in 10% of calls, the most of any column. The model names 84% there and hesitates 1.23 bits, the window's peak. Then columns 20 to 31 are spine, 91 to 93%, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 7 to 10% of calls, named 88 to 95%, fewest and most hesitant at column 20 (`yejM`), 88%, 1.15 bits.

**A variable column follows at 32** (`pdeN`), then spine columns 33 to 38, 91 to 93%, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 10% of calls, named 93 to 97%. Columns 39 to 53 mix variable columns and short spines: `setB`, then `fruB` to `fruA`, then `psuK` and `psuG`, then `psuT`, then `yeiL` to `arnF`. The model names 72 to 98% across these, fewest at column 49 (`yeiI`), 72%.

**The last spine runs from `yeiG` to `preT`**, columns 55 to 63, 91 to 92%, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 5% of calls, named 94 to 98%. Columns 64 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 10% of calls, named 89 to 98%, fewest at column 69, 89%, most hesitant at column 70, 0.69 bits. The window ends at column 79, `yehY`, in 66% of chromosomes.

**Across the window the model names 95% of genes**, 0.25 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.66 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 52% against 97%.

label: mqo
facts:
WINDOW: the mqo window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor mqo, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,500 to 1,579 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying mqo once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.25 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 39,896 calls, named 98%, 0.15 bits; shell 2,667 calls, named 69%, 1.17 bits; cloud 397 calls, named 7%, 3.29 bits. Outside an RGP 40,938 calls, named 97%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 2,022 calls, named 52%, 1.66 bits. Columns: 55 spine, 2 fork, 23 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.66 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (52% against 97%); 2,022 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 19 (yejO) 1.23 bits, RGP 10%; column 20 (yejM) 1.15 bits, RGP 10%; column 2 (yojO) 0.95 bits, RGP 0.2%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 19 (fork), RGP 10%; the least: columns 40-42 (spine), RGP 2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-18 (19 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0-5%. Genes: mqo, eco, yojO "protein YojO", napF, napD, napA, napG, napH, napB "nitrate reductase cytochrome c-type…", napC, ccmA, ccmB, ccmC, ccmD, ccmE, ccmF "cytochrome c-type biogenesis heme l…", dsbE, ccmH, narP. named 97-99.8% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 18 (narP), named 97%; most hesitant at column 2 (yojO), 0.95 bits.
2. column 19 fork: RGP 10%. named 84%; 1.23 bits.
   19: yejO S 72% "AIDA repeat-containing protein"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 16%
3. columns 20-31 (12 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 7-10%. Genes: yejM "DUF3413 domain-containing protein", yejL "DUF1414 domain-containing protein", yejK "nucleoid-associated protein", rplY, radD, rsuA, bcr, yejG "YejG family protein", yejF "ATP-binding cassette domain-contain…", yejE "ABC transporter permease", yejB "microcin C ABC transporter permease…", yejA "extracellular solute-binding protein". named 88-95% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 20 (yejM), named 88%, 1.15 bits.
4. column 32 variable: RGP 8%. named 92%; 0.55 bits.
   32: pdeN P 90%
5. columns 33-38 (6 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 3-10%. Genes: mepS, lpxT, yeiR "CobW family GTP-binding protein", yeiQ "NAD-dependent D-mannonate oxidoredu…", yeiP "elongation factor P-like protein Ye…", yeiW. named 93-97% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 33 (mepS), named 93%; most hesitant at column 34 (lpxT), 0.28 bits.
6. column 39 variable: RGP 2%. named 96%; 0.29 bits.
   39: setB P 89%
7. columns 40-42 (3 columns) spine: share 92-93%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: fruB "fused PTS fructose transporter subu…", fruK, fruA. named 95-98% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 42 (fruA), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 42 (fruA)).
8. columns 43-44 (2 columns) variable: RGP 2%. named 89-95% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 43, named 89%, 0.37 bits.
   43: psuK P 88%
   44: psuG P 89% "pseudouridine-5'-phosphate glycosid…"
9. column 45 spine: share 93%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: psuT. named 96%; 0.20 bits.
10. columns 46-48 (3 columns) variable: RGP 2%. named 86-94% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 48, named 86%; most hesitant at column 46, 0.26 bits.
   46: yeiL P 88% "transcriptional regulator YeiL"
   47: rihB P 90%
   48: arnF P 5%
11. columns 49-53 (5 columns) spine: share 91-93%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: yeiI "PfkB family carbohydrate kinase", nfo, yeiH "putative sulfate exporter family tr…", yieE "LysR family transcriptional regulat…", lysP. named 72-98% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 49 (yeiI), named 72%; most hesitant at column 53 (lysP), 0.26 bits.
12. column 54 variable: RGP 5%. named 93%; 0.52 bits.
   54: cirA S 84%
13. columns 55-63 (9 columns) spine: share 91-92%, all P, RGP 3-5%. Genes: yeiG "alpha/beta hydrolase-fold protein", folE, yeiB "DUF418 domain-containing protein Ye…", galS, mglB, mglA, mglC "ABC transporter permease subunit", preA "4Fe-4S binding protein", preT. named 94-98% (mean 96%), fewest named at column 55 (yeiG), named 94%; most hesitant at column 60 (mglA), 0.36 bits.
14. columns 64-79 (16 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 2-10%. named 89-98% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 69, named 89%; most hesitant at column 70, 0.69 bits.
   columns 64-78 variable, share 71-89%, all P: yeiS "DUF2542 family protein" 89%, sanA 88%, cdd 88%, yohK "LrgB family protein" 87%, yohJ "CidA/LrgA family protein" 87%, dusC 86%, yohP "small membrane protein YohP" 80%, mdtQ 77%, yohF "SDR family oxidoreductase" 80%, yohD "DedA family protein" 80%, yohC "Yip1 family protein" 76%, pbpG 74%, dld 72%, bglX 71%, osmF 71%
   79 fork: yehY P 66% "ABC transporter permease"; also yehX P 33%, yehW P 16%
